about: Curated command knowledge for the console assistant (web/assistant.js): descriptions in en/ru, subcommands (sub), flags and ready one-liners (examples). Purely local, never executed.

status.en: is a service running, last log lines
status.ru: работает ли служба, последние строки журнала

reload.en: re-read the config without a restart

list-timers.en: scheduled timers and their next run

daemon-reload.en: re-read unit files after editing them

mask.en: forbid starting a unit at all

-b.en: since this boot (-b -1: the previous one)

--disk-usage.en: how much space the journal takes

exec.en: run a command inside a container

inspect.en: all details of a container or image
inspect.ru: все подробности о контейнере или образе

stats.ru: процессор и память по контейнерам вживую

--remove-orphans.en: remove containers not in the file
--remove-orphans.ru: удалить контейнеры, которых нет в файле
